answer:
## UI polish: Pro plan

I made 15 fixes covering spacing, typography, contrast, hierarchy, states, layout and motion, plus token swaps. Text and brand hue are unchanged. Tokens are from tokens.css.

### Fixes
1. **Spacing**: The card's `padding: 14px` was off the scale. It's now `padding: var(--space-16)` (14 is halfway between 12 and 16, so it goes to the larger one). (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20)
2. **Spacing**: The heading's `margin: 0 0 3px` is now `margin: 0 0 var(--space-4)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20)
3. **Spacing**: The tag's `padding: 2px 8px` is now `padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-8)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20)
4. **Spacing**: The buttons' `padding: 5px 9px` is now `padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-8)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20)
5. **Typography**: The heading's `font-size: 19px` was off the scale. It's now `var(--font-size-xl)` (20px), with `line-height: var(--line-height-heading)` and `font-weight: var(--font-weight-strong)` instead of the browser's default 700. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-8, R-ui-polish-20)
6. **Typography**: The description's `font-size: 13px` was below 16px for body text. It's now `var(--font-size-md)`, with `line-height: var(--line-height-body)` and `max-width: var(--measure)`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-20)
7. **Typography**: The buttons had no size, weight or line-height set. They now use `var(--font-size-md)`, `var(--line-height-body)` and `var(--font-weight-strong)`, and the tag uses `var(--font-weight-regular)`. The card now uses only two weights. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-8, R-ui-polish-20)
8. **Contrast**: The description's `#9ca3af` on `#ffffff` was 2.54:1. It's now `var(--color-text-muted)`, which is 6.38:1. (R-ui-polish-4, R-ui-polish-20)
9. **Hierarchy**: Both buttons were filled with `#0f766e`. "Upgrade now" is now the only primary action, using `--color-action-primary-bg` and `--color-action-primary-text`. "Compare plans" is now an outline button: transparent background, with `--color-action-secondary-text` and `--color-action-secondary-border`. (R-ui-polish-5, R-ui-polish-21)
10. **States**: Buttons had no hover or pressed style. The primary button now darkens on hover (`--color-action-primary-bg-hover`) and when pressed (`--color-action-primary-bg-pressed`), and the secondary button gets `--color-selected-bg`. (R-ui-polish-6)
11. **States**: There was no focus style. Buttons now get `outline: var(--border-width-focus) solid var(--color-border-focus); outline-offset: 2px` on `:focus-visible`. (R-ui-polish-6)
12. **States**: There was no disabled style. Buttons now get `opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed` on `:disabled`. (R-ui-polish-6)
13. **Layout**: Buttons were about 28px tall, below the 44px minimum. They now have `min-height` and `min-width` set to `var(--size-target-min)`. (R-ui-polish-7)
14. **Motion**: The `transition: background .3s` had no reduced-motion fallback. It's now `var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-standard)` and is turned off under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. (R-ui-polish-9, R-ui-polish-20)
15. **Tokens**: Raw values are now tokens: the `#202d2c` text, `#fff` background and `#0f766e` buttons (colours); the `1px solid #e5e7eb` borders (now `--border-width-hairline` with `--color-border-default`); the `5px` and `9999px` radii (now `--radius-md`, `--radius-control` and `--radius-full`); and `system-ui` (now `--font-family-sans`). (R-ui-polish-20)
